Class CarManager

java.lang.Object
edu.valencia.cardms.CarManager
public class CarManager extends Object
Manages car operations for the Car Data Management System. This class connects the graphical user interface to the DatabaseManager. It handles adding, retrieving, updating, deleting, and importing car records.
